d: As the air thickens with the onset of winter, India and Pakistan struggle with hazardous air pollution, with cities from both countries topping the rankings of the world’s most polluted urban centres. Every winter, Pakistan blames India for its pollution, like it did this year after Diwali, when the environment minister of its Punjab province attributed Lahore’s pollution to air carried in from India. Watch ThePrint's Bantirani Patro discuss how some voices from the two countries propose ‘smog diplomacy’ or ‘climate diplomacy’ to bring New Delhi and Islamabad to the table and find…
